description: Backup/restore, open-source docs, secret hygiene, CI and final hardening (PLAN.md items 29-32). Implements ossctl backup/restore with age-encrypted archives into gitignored backups/ (DESIGN §18.8) and the Windows wrappers, writes README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/SETUP.md (disaster recovery from a fresh Windows install), docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, .kiro/steering/*, .kiro/agents/harness-dev.json, .gitleaks.toml, .githooks/pre-commit + scripts/install-hooks.ps1, ossctl lint personal and ossctl docs commands, the optional GitHub Actions CI (lint/tests/gitleaks, SHA-pinned, contents: read), and runs the complete required overall verification. Depends on everything before it.
